text:
In caverns deep where shadows creep,
A silent world of wisdom sleeps.
No echo breaks the hallowed air,
Save whispers from a thousand years.

Each spine a door, each page a key,
To lives unknown and worlds unseen,
Where curiosity sets us free,
And human striving is the dream.

Beneath the gaze of one who knows,
The keeper of the boundless store,
Who counts the tales that everyone
Has read, or yet to read before.

Yet amidst this vast and quiet sea,
A fact stands firm, distinct and clear:
The largest bone in anatomy,
The one that supports the weight of fear,
Is the femur, strong and long,
The pillar of the human frame.
